title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 14 in F-sharp minor

character.text: Learned triple fugue: each subject exposed separately, then combined

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: the opening of the subject (2 times).

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of subject 2 (2 times). Alto: the opening of subject 2. Bass: the opening of subject 2.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in B minor (Alto); Subject 2 (Bass)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of subject 2. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in C♯ minor (Bass); Subject 3 (Alto); Subject 3 (Soprano); Subject 3 (Bass); Subject 3 (Alto)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from subject 3. Bass: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 7–8) in part, with the soprano's line in the bass, the alto's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from subject 3 (5 times) and a figure from subject 3, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from subject 3 (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from subject 3, inverted (4 times) and a figure from subject 3 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Link
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from subject 3, inverted. Bass: a figure from subject 3, inverted and a figure from subject 3.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fourth every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 3 (2 times) and a figure from subject 3, inverted (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fifth every half bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in C♯ minor, rhythm varied (Bass); Subject 3 (Soprano); Subject 2 (Alto)
Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of subject 3. Alto: a figure from subject 3, inverted and a figure from subject 3, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from subject 3, inverted (3 times) and a figure from subject 3 (2 times) and a figure from subject 2, in a sequence falling by a step every bar.

sections.label: Combination: Subject in F♯ minor, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject 3 (Alto); Subject 2 (Bass)
